title: Pin the case-fold table digest: a test that fails on drift of unicode-case-folding (DEC-282 (a12) pair item)
description: DEC-282 (a12) (opum-doc, opum-ai/opum-doc#1870 family): the lore/quest pair shares one case-fold table, and a change to it is a pair change with a digest test failing in whichever half lags. lore pins the CASE_FOLD_TABLE_DATA string of its vendored, generated file (src/adapters/case-fold-table.ts; digest ef08b22d969b928737ae158c7a0d2bc4b800769b178f99db69f21bd68255fc13, each entry String.fromCodePoint(cp) plus String.fromCodePoint(...mapped), ascending, joined by "\n" with no trailing newline, hashed as UTF-8) and never reads the library. quest had no such test: unicode-case-folding is used only in src/domain/records.ts (caseFold), package.json (^1.1.1) and bun.lock, so a lockfile regen resolving 1.1.2 would silently diverge from lore. TEST ONLY: pin the fold data quest actually uses, in quest own representation (every code point 0..0x10FFFF, lookupFolding(cp) when defined, one line "<cp hex>:<mapped hex,...>\n", sha256; 1585 entries at 1.1.1, C+F statuses) AND build lore exact representation from the same runtime table and assert lore digest, so one shared constant is pinned in both repos. Do not change package.json or bun.lock (a dependency path needing a floor check first).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test pins the sha256 of the lookupFolding table of the installed unicode-case-folding (1585 entries at 1.1.1), stating exactly what it hashes
The test goes red when the table drifts (shown by a mutant that perturbs one entry or the entry count)
No change to package.json or bun.lock

plan: 1. Pin quest table in its own representation (digest bea3c0c9..., 1585 entries) - landed in round 1.

2. Round 2 of the work (round-1 opus verdict, sha256 0a58aa155ebb3290a0d89d942bfb20e52fd4e08ffa8f62849e9e93e925e6026b, quest-773-verdict.txt): also build lore exact representation from quest runtime table and assert ef08b22d... (B1); measured: quest table produces it, no pair finding.
3. SF1: pin caseFold (the function src calls) against lookupFolding at every code point.
4. SF2: foldTable takes the lookup; wrappers altering one F entry and dropping one code point must move both digests; rename the test.
5. Nits: drop the surrogate skip, add the C+F comment, correct the description.
implementationNotes: Round-1 review of opum-ai/quest-cli#773 (head a9d69ea6): REQUEST CHANGES, one blocker (B1 two self-pins, no shared constant), SF1, SF2, nits. Verdict file quest-773-verdict.txt in the opum-agent scratchpad, sha256 0a58aa155ebb3290a0d89d942bfb20e52fd4e08ffa8f62849e9e93e925e6026b. Measured at unicode-case-folding 1.1.1: quest runtime table in lore exact form hashes to ef08b22d969b928737ae158c7a0d2bc4b800769b178f99db69f21bd68255fc13 over 1585 entries, equal to lore pin, so no pair finding. Mutants shown red: lore pin one character off (pin test and drift test), wrapper made a no-op (drift test), caseFold-vs-table disagreement (caseFold test). The surrogate skip was dropped; no surrogate key exists, so the quest digest bea3c0c9... is unchanged.

Round-2 review of opum-ai/quest-cli#773 at 026fe12e: APPROVE, no blockers or should-fix. Verdict file quest-773-r2-verdict.txt in the opum-agent scratchpad, sha256 310af80c42c4cb929b5dfbb2adeb340c96d82e00a2dff70fd4df4616ce2d4a36. Its coordination item is met: lore-cli dev test/lcli791-quest-rollup.test.ts pins ef08b22d... (lore-cli#753), so both halves carry the shared constant. Landed as squash e1e8ff95186c87bcf09b1a7e278e53e6aa2bab3d. Optional nit N2 (test perf) skipped for 0.15.1.

Round 2 asserts lore's representation digest ef08b22d969b928737ae158c7a0d2bc4b800769b178f99db69f21bd68255fc13 (lore's recipe: cp+mapped per entry, ascending, joined by newline, no trailing newline, UTF-8) beside quest's own bea3c0c9 pin, MEASURED equal over 1585 entries at unicode-case-folding 1.1.1; lore dev pins the same constant (test/lcli791-quest-rollup.test.ts). Not exercised: a real 1.1.2 resolution moving either digest.
finalSummary: Pinned the fold data quest uses (test/qcli579-case-fold-table-digest.test.ts, landed as e1e8ff95 via opum-ai/quest-cli#773): quest's own digest bea3c0c9 over 1585 entries and lore's exact-form digest ef08b22d, which lore also pins, so one shared constant carries the pair; caseFold is pinned against the table at every code point. Verified: mutants (lore pin off by one, a no-op wrapper, a caseFold/table disagreement) each go red; package.json and bun.lock untouched; Opus round-2 APPROVE at 026fe12e.
